structured_JSON_method.qualification: All distinct text values were viewed with first JSON pointers. Hashes, byte sizes and repeated receipt/status structures were parsed and bound mechanically; no new semantic reapproval of the 56 historical source domains.

generation_map_is_not_read_receipt: Blank lines carry no prose; exact repeated complete lines refer to their first occurrence in complete-content-line-map.json. Page generation alone was never counted as reading. Truncated displays were supplemented.
